title: Akeled
html_source:
akeled – Obsolete: “cooled,
became cold.”

A little anecdote about Joyce’s use of this word:

http://digicoll.library.wisc.edu/cgi-bin/JoyceColl/JoyceColl-idx?type=turn&entity=JoyceColl.BudgenUlysses.p0045&id=JoyceColl.BudgenUlysses&isize=text

The Chatterton in the anecdote is Thomas Chatterton, poet (1752-1770).
